notes:
POC scope: latency-sensitive personalization and reranking slice for feed and ad auctions. Primary goal: p95 inference <= 80ms and cost per 1M requests < $1200 after batching/caching/quantization.

Key requirements / constraints:
- Traffic profile: bursty (500-1,200 rps peaks), median request length small (prompt ~ 120 tokens), many short prefix matches for caching.
- Throughput target: sustained 600 rps with headroom for 1,200 rps peaks.
- Latency target: p50 < 20ms, p95 < 80ms (hard SLO for ad auctions).
- Cost sensitivity: high — must reduce per-token spend vs current OpenAI-hosted (~30-40% reduction target).
- Model preferences: open models (Llama-2-family or equivalent), willing to test 13B 4-bit/8-bit quantized variants; fallback to smaller 7B for specific routes.
- Routing: per-route model selection and automatic fallback when Dedicated pool is saturated.
- Operational: need request tracing and token-level cost breakdown, canary rollouts for new quantization profiles.

Summary of recent conversations:
- 2026-01-14 kick-off call (Diego + SE + eng lead). Action: deliver perf baseline with unquantized 13B by 2026-01-28.
- 2026-02-05 security sync (Priya + security lead). Provided SOC2 artifacts; asked for draft KMS integration doc.
- 2026-02-11 async call (Fireflies ff_20260211...). Eng asked about KV cache semantics and whether Redwood supports shard-local KV caching for per-user session prefixes.
- 2026-02-24 perf sync: ran baseline on hosted and measured p95 ~ 210ms on standard hosting for 13B unquantized; discuss quantization and batching plans.

1) Week 1: baseline perf across hosted vs dedicated (unquantized 13B). deliver metrics + flamegraphs.
2) Week 2: implement batching and prefix/KV cache for session prefixes (expect 30-40% token reduction).
3) Week 3: quantization experiments (int8, 4-bit) + kernel tuning; measure quality delta on held-out rerank set (NDCG).
4) Week 4: run sustained throughput tests (600rps) and failover/routing exercises; produce cost model.

- Perf bench harness: synthetic arrival with real burst traces (file: drive/SampledTrafficFeb.log).
- They want a reproducible perf recipe: seed, prompt templates, tokenization details, and kernel config.

- Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations automated into console (batch size suggestions, quant profile presets).
